description: An async App Router function exported from a page.tsx or layout.tsx file that awaits route params and returns dynamic SEO and Open Graph metadata.
An explicit allowlist in next.config.ts (defaulting to [75]) that restricts which quality values the Next.js Image Optimization API will accept, preventing CDN cache fragmentation.
The minimum duration in seconds (defaulting to 14400, or 4 hours) that Next.js caches optimized remote images when upstream origin Cache-Control headers do not specify a longer TTL.
A security allowlist in next.config.ts specifying the exact protocol, hostname, port, and pathname globs permitted for external image optimization.
A per-request cryptographic token generated in proxy.ts and forwarded via x-nonce and Content-Security-Policy headers so Next.js and inline scripts can execute safely without unsafe-inline.
